-- intro: Blood Healing Magic: Curse-Breaking Blood Cocoon is a blood-based Healing Magic spell.
-- Description:
    With an open grimoire, the user points their finger at a target. Veins of blood extend from the finger, envelope the target in a large dark orb, and surround the wounded part of the target, healing it. The transfusion of blood is capable of strengthening the target after they are healed, and also allows the user to take control of the target's body. This spell can also be bottled and used remotely.
